The performing edition and any editorial alterations are not identified in the recording sources.

[1]
Recorded
22 April 1929 Documented

Both Andante sides were recorded on this day. The complete symphony also required a session on 24 April; Commons’ 1 January 1929 is not the session day.

Symphony Hall, Boston, Massachusetts, United States Documented[4] [5]

Catalogue

The upstream transfer identifies set M-55. DAHR supplies the disc number for the two Andante sides.

[3] [4] [5]
Matrix, take, sides
CVE-48984, take 1: Andante, part 3; CVE-48985, take 3: Andante concluded, part 4. Documented

These are the issued takes listed for M-55. No run-out inspection or aural take comparison has been performed on the digital surrogate.

[4] [5]
Transfer
Bob Varney — transfer from original Victor 78s Documented[3]
Transfer date
Unknown Unknown

No transfer date is identified. Upload and release dates are not treated as transfer dates.

[1]
Processing
Transfer from the original Victor 78 rpm set M-55. Documented

The transfer is documented; stylus, playback curve, side-join locations and noise treatment are not. The Commons movement is extracted from an upstream complete-symphony file, but the extraction procedure is not documented.

[3]
Composition rights
Underlying composition is out of copyright where the ordinary life-plus-70 term applies. Inferred, not documented

The composer died in 1809. This is a term calculation, not a worldwide clearance or a statement about an unidentified modern edition.

[6] [7]
Recording rights
Rule 3 — territorial: sound recording public domain in the European Union (pre-1963 publication basis). Documented

Commons applies PD-EU-audio to the Koussevitzky/Boston recording attributed to 1929. The alternative CC0 metadata is not needed and is not treated as authority to waive Victor’s rights. Usable under the programme’s pre-1963 European sound-recording rule; the former 50-year term had expired before the 2013 extension. This is territorial, not a worldwide licence; US sound-recording status is not established. A recording date alone is not represented as an independently verified first-publication date.

  • PD-EU-audio — European performers’ and producers’ rights claimed expired.
  • CC0 — dedication asserted by Commons Structured data.
